name: Is it better to hire a professional painter or paint the interior myself?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to hire a professional painter or paint the interior myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a professional ensures clean cut lines, proper surface preparation, and long-lasting adhesion, saving you significant time and effort. DIY painting often leads to visible brush marks, thin coverage, and messy edges around baseboards and ceilings, especially on large walls or stairwells. Working with a contractor like Abraham Becerra provides single-contact oversight, professional-grade prep tools, and integrated drywall repair, while DIY projects often stall or require professional correction for patched spots and uneven sheen.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a professional provides smooth finishes, durable coverage, and seamless drywall patching, saving you time and avoiding costly DIY touch-up mistakes.
